title: LTX 2.3 reference-to-video: bench-test the Ingredients IC-LoRA

summary: Scope grew to shipping Reference to Video on the LTX 2.3 model; large plan written (plan.md), bench combos queued.
Two-stage proof on the shipped LTX int8 graph: variant A (stage-2 guide) picked; no-sheet t2v/i2v byte-identical to shipped.
Phase 2b layout bench done: packed canvas-tiling sheet of whole pictures (76-79% fill) works; black margins, split views and undescribed pictures each fail.
Sheet composer ported to sharp (routes/ingredientsSheet.js), /engine-sheet route, _composeReferenceSheet hook; 9/9 unit tests, layout identical to the bench.
Phase 3+4: HF re-host verified, ltx23-lora-ingredients dep on both LTX cards, raw template spliced; generated graph equals the bench-run insert(A), 0 diffs; 32/32 workflow tests.
Parallel Batch done: ref2v_ms on both LTX cards (slots narrowed, D5 help, priority, role text), audioMode gated on audioRouting, recipe r2v mode + agent guide.
Unit suite 3039 pass / 0 fail; release:check red only on MPI-623 engine pin. Phase 5 live verify next.
